title: Project Specialist Graduate
teaser: Take on the role of Project Specialist Graduate and contribute to Cisco’s Customer Experience team in Lisbon. Support business operations, participate in professional development, and gain hands-on experience across multiple teams. Ideal for recent graduates or final-year Master’s students with strong English and French skills and a passion for technology.
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Project Specialist (Graduate / Early in Career)

Location: Lisbon, Portugal (following Cisco’s hybrid work approach) 

Start date: October 2026

Applications are accepted until further notice.   

Meet the team: Recurring Revenue Acceleration (RRA) is an organization that drives growth, increases renewal rates, and reduces customer attrition for Cisco services and software by proactively partnering with Customers, Partners, and Field teams in Germany, South, MEA-TRC, UKI, North, and Service Provider Theaters. Our organization has roles ranging from Renewals Managers, Renewals Specialists, Business Development Managers, Deal Development Teams, Business Operations Managers, and Strategy and Planning.  We account for 51% of Cisco’s revenue and actively leverage AI internally and with our customers to drive our business.

Your impact:

Cisco’s Customer Experience (CX) Recurring Revenue Acceleration Team is seeking talented, inquisitive problem-solvers to join us for a 12-month new graduate rotational program. CX PROPEL is a new program designed to give recent college graduates professional development training, hands-on work experience, and career acceleration opportunities. Participants will be part of an exceptionally bright, collaborative, and driven cohort. The program will be based out of Cisco’s Lisbon office, where you will have the opportunity to participate in networking and volunteer events as well as in-person training, executive speaker series, mentoring, and more! 

Throughout the 12-month program, you will rotate to two different teams (6 months each) providing you with visibility across the Customer Experience organization and an array of professional experiences. 

  

Minimum Qualifications   

Recent graduate or those in the final year of a Master’s degree in Business, Management, ICT field, or holders of similar academic background. Equivalent experience accepted in lieu of a degree  

You speak English and French at a fluent level 

Interested in the business and operations side of the technology industry 

Comfortable in a fast-paced ever-changing environment 

Intellectually curious, a quick learner, adaptable, independent, and a self-starter 

Results and data driven  

Eligible to live and work in Lisbon without visa support or sponsorship 

Preferred Qualifications

You show strong communication and collaboration skills with a real passion for solving problems   

You have excellent organization and time management skills   

You are process oriented with drive to simplify/improve process   

You possess effective time-management skills and the ability to prioritize work assignments   

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
